notes: Background: Marlin Harbor is a mid-market SaaS vendor (marketplace + analytics). Building an in-app conversational assistant and better search for product docs.
Evaluation path: started with Hosted API (quick demo + PoC). Satisfied w/ quality but need predictability and lower unit cost for production scale -> evaluating Dedicated.
POC highlights: Hosted API POC (Jan-Feb 2026) showed 15% latency tail on long contexts; embeddings match-rate ~0.78 on internal eval set.
Performance targets: p95 < 250ms for short chat messages (<=256 tokens), sustained throughput ~50 req/s during peak; burst to 150 req/s for seasonal spikes.
Cost sensitivity: Moderate - willing to commit if unit cost and predictable billing reduce RPU by >=30% vs hosted list.
Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified variants (Falcon/LLama-based quantized builds). Want ability to pin versions and fallback to quantized variant automatically.
Routing/fallback: require policy to fall back to cheaper quantized model for non-critical reranking calls; automatic regional fallback for outages.
Security: strict data residency needs for EU customers; must support VPC deployment, customer-managed KMS and audit logs pushed to their SIEM.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-20): 'We need predictable monthly unit costs and the confidence that bursting won't blow our budget.'
Commercial asks: 12-month and 24-month commit options, staged ramp with initial lower commit + automatic scale windows, clear overage pricing and burst pooling, SLA numbers for latency/uptime.

AE notes: pushing two commercial constructs - (A) 12mo commit: 2 reserved GPUs baseline, burst to 4, 20% discounted overage; (B) 24mo deeper discount + flexible burst credits. Need legal to sign off on data residency addendum.
